explanations.explanation: That one sounds familiar because it's a real line in Revelation. The four living creatures say, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty." (Revelation 4:8) But the name on the rider's robe and thigh is KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS. (Revelation 19:16)
